note: Twelve laws minted or amended 2026-09-28..30 inventoried with founding incident receipt, enforcement mechanism (7 with exit codes in the tool path, the rest named as prose or control-flow-only), falsifier, and the jacket each kills; every quote byte-verified by the battery in laws.check.txt.

rows.law: THE ONE-BUG LAW (B2-216 generalized: verdicts carry their conditions)
rows.claim: Minted 2026-09-29 ~20:07 after operator 'now everywhere one bug, many jackets': seven jackets in one night, one bug, verdicts consumed without the conditions that produced them (report order, in-repo-vs-out-of-repo context, head exit code, check side-effects, reasoning budget). Founding receipt: commit 98071f556 (rib addendum only file touched) + incident receipts watch/inbox/ball3/driver-meter.md and commit 26eacaae7. Mechanism: the general law is PROSE in the rib (memory/rib/RIB_DRIVING_LADDER_20260928.md:53-76) but its named instances are exit-coded: --no-register (tools/workflow_gate.py:281,312), _rel_posix (tools/stealth_driver.py:460), hermetic basetemp (conftest.py:14-23), max_tokens 12000 (tools/corpus_lens_run.py:45). Jacket killed: the verdict-without-conditions jacket (any consumption of an instrument result whose instrument/exit/moment/context go unnamed).
rows.quote:
A VERDICT WITHOUT ITS
CONDITIONS IS NOT A VERDICT.
rows.steal: Before the next instrument receipt you write, add a 4-line Conditions block (instrument+exit, moment, cwd/basetemp/order assumptions) at the top of its Checks section; template lives in watch/inbox/48h_synth/laws.md.
rows.falsifier: The next cross-context verdict disagreement that takes TWO investigations to resolve to a named condition difference proves the law was ignored (rib line 75-76).

rows.law: SEAT LAW GATE rule 1: bare python on PATH blocks
rows.claim: Minted 2026-09-29 18:57 (commit 185965898) after the operator's 'I keep fucking watching you ignore laws': the seat ran bare python on PATH all night (the Hermes-misresolution class that broke stealth_driver's selffeed). Mechanism: tools/seat_law_gate.py:37 (BARE_PY regex) and :76-83 (exit 2 with AGENTS.md citation), registered PreToolUse on Bash|Write|Edit at C:/Users/foste/.zcode/cli/config.json:50. Fail-open on internal error (seat_law_gate.py:26-27,114-115). Jacket killed: the agents-cannot-self-police jacket (field verdict sw-10: LLM-proposes, deterministic-verifier-disposes; laws with exit codes in the tool path are the ones that hold).
rows.quote: Bash invoking bare python/python3 (no path prefix, not pythonw) -> exit 2
rows.steal: On the next SEAT LAW Bash refusal, switch to .venv/Scripts/python.exe immediately with zero retries, then name the refusal in your lane receipt.

rows.law: SEAT LAW GATE rule 2: no em/en-dash in authored watch/inbox content
rows.claim: Minted 2026-09-29 18:57 in the same commit 185965898 (the elder-consult receipt's 5 em-dashes were normalized in that commit). Mechanism: tools/seat_law_gate.py:38 (DASHES regex U+2013/U+2014) and :84-107 (exit 2 on introduced dash), same hook registration (config.json:50). Jacket killed: the AI-tell jacket (em-dash as machine-prose fingerprint in the estate record).
rows.quote: en-dash -> exit 2. Law: the no-em-dash AI-tell rule
rows.steal: Scan your next authored receipt for U+2013/U+2014 before the Write lands; on refusal replace with plain hyphens and re-save.

Mechanism: tools/seat_law_gate.py:43-65 (gate_workflow_content, temp payload through workflow_gate) + :108-112 (PreToolUse Write of *.dwf.ts blocks RED before landing), and tools/seat_law_postgate.py:30-45 (PostToolUse Edit witness on the whole file, registered at config.json:84). rows.law: --no-register: payload gate-checks are verdicts, not ledger facts
rows.claim: Minted 2026-09-29 20:04 (commit 26eacaae7): every payload gate-check called workflow_gate check which appended a REGISTRY row per run, minting junk rows pointing at %TEMP% files that died milliseconds later (4 live seatlaw_* rows confirmed, preserved per append-only law in memory/workflows/REGISTRY.jsonl). Mechanism: tools/workflow_gate.py:281-286 (flag def) and :312-314 (early return preserving the exit contract 2-if-failed-else-0); caller tools/seat_law_gate.py:50 passes it. Jacket killed: the append-only-ledger pollution jacket (a check mistaking itself for a landed fact).
rows.quote: rows pointing at temp files that die immediately
rows.steal: Pass --no-register on every workflow_gate invocation from a hook or script; reserve registered rows for real submit-time gate checks.
rows.falsifier: Any hook payload gate-check that appends a row to memory/workflows/REGISTRY.jsonl means the flag stopped being passed.

rows.law: Dash-introduce edge: only NEWLY-INTRODUCED dashes block
rows.claim: Amended 2026-09-29 20:04 in the same commit 26eacaae7: the rule-2 dash scan false-blocked full-content re-saves of files carrying historical dashes (quoted sources, older house prose). Mechanism: tools/seat_law_gate.py:89-102 (Edit fragment = always new ink; full Write judged against the file on disk by dash count). Jacket killed: the false-positive jacket (lawful re-saves of historical prose blocked, gate taught to be routed around).
rows.quote: Only newly-introduced dashes block: re-saving a file that
rows.steal: When the gate blocks a lawful re-save, normalize the historical dashes out of the file once instead of fighting the gate; the file then re-saves clean forever.
rows.falsifier: Either edge reappearing falsifies: a historically-dashed file blocked on re-save, or a Write introducing a new dash that passes.

rows.law: Hermetic-basetemp law: suites hermetic to basetemp location, code correct out-of-repo
rows.claim: Minted 2026-09-29 across the wave5 suite-burn and the ball3 driver-meter lane: a suite run with pytest basetemp OUTSIDE the repo (suite-burn-w5-full-basetemp-r3) failed 5 gate/dead-hand tests with 'not in the subpath of' ValueErrors that the default in-repo basetemp (conftest.py:14) had masked, making real defects look intermittent across runs. Founding receipts: watch/inbox/gala_20260925/wave5-repair/lanes/suite-burn.check.txt + watch/inbox/ball3/driver-meter.md (root causes 2-4). Mechanism: conftest.py:14-23 (default per-pid in-repo basetemp, pre-created) PLUS the class fixes at root: tools/stealth_driver.py:460 (_rel_posix), mag/agent_state.py:177 (_display_path), tools/violation_ratchet.py:307-310 and tools/config_seal.py:119-122 (display-path try/except to absolute). Jacket killed: the intermittent-failure jacket (in-repo mask hiding a context defect).
rows.quote:
the test passed, which is why it looked intermittent
across runs.
rows.steal: Run your next suite once with --basetemp outside the repo and treat any 'not in the subpath of' failure as a real defect to fix at root, filing it in the lane check.txt.
rows.falsifier: A suite with basetemp outside the repo failing on relative_to while the identical suite passes in-repo (the wave5 shape) means the class fix regressed in some new file.

rows.law: Ordered-reports determinism: concurrent phases dispatch on a stable sort
rows.claim: Minted 2026-09-29 with the ball drivers after 'report order trusted stable' was named one of the seven jackets: concurrent lane phases consumed target order as given, so report order was an accident of arrival. Mechanism: .zcode/workflow-drafts/Ball3-suite-green.dwf.ts:101-104 and tonight's .zcode/workflow-drafts/Burn-48h-synthesis.dwf.ts:103-104 (stable sort by explicit division ORDER map, control flow only, never ask text). Honest status: control-flow determinism inside the driver script, no exit code of its own. Jacket killed: the report-order-trusted-stable jacket.
rows.quote: Stable sort, control flow only - never ask text
rows.steal: In your next fan-out driver, stable-sort the target array by an explicit ORDER map before dispatch instead of trusting args arrival order.
rows.falsifier: Two runs of the same driver with the same lanes dispatching in different orders, or a lane whose ask text was altered by the sort, kills the determinism claim.

rows.law: MINIMAL-EXPOSURE LAW: scripts load only whitelisted env vars, never full .env
rows.claim: Minted 2026-09-30 12:47 (commit 76e29cd0b) from an operator catch ('wont that leak our keys'): run_mate.ps1 loaded full .env, and opencode snapshots shell env, putting 46 live values where they had no business; now it sources ONLY the 2 whitelisted vars the opencode config references (ZAI_API_KEY, ZAI_API_KEY_2). Founding receipt: commit 76e29cd0b, born from the steps.jsonl leak (commit 662dc739e purged history; commit 03738963e wired fail-closed precommit_secret_check). Mechanism: scripts/run_mate.ps1:61-68 (whitelisted foreach, 'never full .env'). Jacket killed: the env-transparency jacket (convenience env loading as a key-exfiltration channel).
rows.quote: whitelisted var(s) for opencode auth (never full .env)
rows.steal: Before any script you write sources .env wholesale, whitelist the exact vars its consumer references in an explicit foreach; landing: the script's env-loading block.
rows.falsifier: Any scheduled or scripted process holding live env values beyond its named consumers (checkable by dumping the process env) means the whitelist was bypassed.

rows.law: No-env-dump law: mates never dump environment into transcripts
rows.claim: Minted 2026-09-30 (commit f4e2c247f 'config seal re-sealed: mates.yaml no-env-dump law', riding commit 76e29cd0b): mates NEVER dump env (env, set, printenv, echo on API-key-shaped names) into transcripts or receipts, because the trajectory hook redacts pre-write but the mate transcript does not. Founding receipt: configs/mates.yaml:17-19, law born 2026-09-30 from the steps.jsonl leak. Mechanism: persona contract prose in configs/mates.yaml PLUS the code-side trajectory redaction hook (commit 76e29cd0b) and the fail-closed precommit_secret_check (commit 03738963e); the persona line itself is prose-only. Jacket killed: the transcript-as-leak jacket (a mate's honest debug output laundering live keys into the record).
rows.quote: NEVER dump environment variables (env, set, printenv, echo on API-key-shaped names)
rows.steal: Add the no-env-dump contract line to the next agent persona or prompt file you author; landing: its contract section, one line above the path-report law.
rows.falsifier: A mate transcript or receipt containing an env dump with live values that survives the trajectory hook redaction means both the persona line and the hook failed.

decision_changed: Closes the 48h constitutional delta for the fold: the estate's laws moved from memory-trust to tool-path enforcement (9 of the 12 inventoried laws now carry code-side mechanisms, seat rules 1-3 and --no-register and the dash-introduce edge and minimal-exposure among them with exit codes or whitelists; SPEND and the one-bug law's general form are honestly prose-only), and the one-bug law makes condition-naming mandatory on every verdict consumption.
